sentences.en: Stars undergo nuclear reactions that burn hydrogen in their cores.
sentences.zh: 恒星在其核心进行核反应，燃烧氢。

sentences.en: It's quite likely that FIFA is rotten to the core.
sentences.zh: 国际足联很可能已经烂到根了。

sentences.en: My mum helps me remove the core of the plum.
sentences.zh: 妈妈帮我把李子的果心去掉了。
